message: Ensemble complete: 126 runs at 20 m (Tr 2/5/10/25/50/100 x drainage capacity 0-60 mm/h x 3 infiltration levels) + 6 runs with capacity weighted by INEGI INV 2020 storm-inlet presence; WebGPU on W10, CPU reference agrees (IoU 0.9997), mass residual <=3.3e-5. 0->40 mm/h removes 54 % (Tr 2) to 25 % (Tr 100) of urban area flooded >=15 cm. Gap classes: a persistente 71.7 km2, b responde al drenaje 55.4 km2. IMEPLAN check: AUC 0.67-0.72 vs random placements. Registered in hazard/index.json: sim-drenaje-routing, -frequency, -gap, -sensitivity. AGEB aggregation (1,948 AGEBs) in ageb-drainage.json. Viewer with capacity slider + ?demo=1 at /labs/sim-drenaje/.
